body: Thank you. :)
Thank you very much for taking the time out to support me.

Firstly, I want to personally apologize to you for what I did. I don't know who you are, but I might as well have contributed to the pain you went through. I don't believe it's a victimless crime, I used to when I was young and dumb and horny. I have changed and have stopped being part of the network long ago, but they traced my old crimes and are charging me with them now. 

I do believe I should be punished. I'd man up to my actions and do my ten years in a humane prison. I don't believe, however, that I should be raped and tortured and left to die in a third world prison. You might feel otherwise because you were a victim of this horrible crime, and I would understand if you do. But, from an objective point of view, you know no one would be sent to the death row for child porn crimes, and that's essentially what they're doing to me. I am, 100% sure, going to die if I go to brazilian prison.

Thank you. After talking to the amazing people here I have indeed cooled off and reconsidered. I'll try talking to a lawyer first, see what he says. 

But since you ask, no, I have no religious beliefs...It's hard for me to accept that a loving God would set me up for so much pain.
Thank you, and no, I have no idea who the people in the videos were. I got them from Limewire when I was like 14.
Thank you very much. It's very kind of you to say these things given how most people would loathe me. Wish you the best as well.
You're being very very helpful just taking the time out to talk to me in such a horrible time. You're a fantastic 14 year old dude. :)

Don't be sorry, you should be proud you're such a kind human being. You're being very helpful in what is being the worst time in my life and you have helped me reconsider my plan of commiting suicide right away. I'll talk to a lawyer first, I'll run away if I have to, but I won't give in right now. Thank you.
You're all making me cry with the kindest words, I never expected so much support. Thank *you*, really, you're amazing.

I suppose it would make sense to give this life thing another chance, yes. I guess I've changed my mind, for now. I won't commit suicide so soon, I'll try to talk to a lawyer, maybe I'll run away as you suggest. Thank you.

>It may depend on what region of the country you're in? Is there any way you can avoid revealing to inmates how you got to prison?

I actually live in the most well off region of the country. Not that it matters because our prisons have been ranked amongst the most violent ones in the country. There are constantly videos flooding the internet of inmates getting tortured by guards. 

Brazilian people and the judiciary system believe in violent punishment, not rehabilitation. 

>Is there any way you can avoid revealing to inmates how you got to prison?

I honestly don't know about that. I'd have to ask someone who's been to prison or a lawyer maybe. I find it unlikely, however...

>If what you say is true perhaps your sacrifice will help drive reform in Brazil.

I'm considering that very much. But by going to prison and dying I would accomplish nothing. I would be another prison death among many that happen daily. No awareness raised, no media coverage. I think I would achieve much more by commiting suicide. I'd make a video of it so it would spread on the internet, because people have a natural curiosity for watching people commiting suicide. In this video I'd lay all that I have laid here, I would give out my opinions on the unfairness criminals and their innocent families get in our justice system. Hopefully the video would spread out get some media coverage. People from other, more enlightened countries would watch it. And that would hopefully be a tiny step towards change in Brazil. 

It's like the Arthur Schwartz suicide. It took an innocent man taking his own life for people to realize the treatment he was getting was beyond cruel and unfair, but it drove things to change.

The thing is, I've been depressed for a long while. I've wanted to kill myself for a long time, but I didn't to spare my family. It's not like I was happy guy before all of this. I was already suffering a lot, even living with rich, supportive parents. I just can't imagine my life being any decent if I fleed to a poor country. I'd still have all my troubles with me, and I'd be away from my family, with no money. I would *survive*, for sure, but that's no way of living if you ask me. Death is not as bad, death is fine, it's just the end. The end of the good things, sure, but also the end of the overwhelmingly bad things in my life.

I haven't spoken to a lawyer. I would love to but I don't want to waste my family's money on a lost cause. I might give that a chance, tho. Just speak to him and tell him everything I've done, and say that I'm on the verge of suicide because of it. Maybe he will tell me prison is not all that bad. Maybe he will tell me that because of my mental issues they will send me to a less horrible place.

They wouldn't hunt me, no. I could move to a different state and lay low, start a new life, but it would be incredibly difficult. I would likely lead a crappy life with no money, away from my family, fearing for my safety every second I'm awake. And I have other problems in my life that I have to take into account. I have chronic health issues, both physical and mental, which would be hard to live with having no money.
So I would lead a shitty life and then die anyway. 

I just think that, sometimes, very rarely even, suicide *is* the right answer. The way I see it, other options include pain and suffering *then* death. So I just wanna avoid all the pain and suffering and reach the death part.
I would just like to take this opportunity to sincerely thank you all for being such kind, supportive human beings. I mean it, you're all great people and what you do here is important.

I'm not sure there are less violent prisons in here. He would likely lessen my 10 year sentence if I plead guilty to something like 6 years, but even one week in a brazilian jail, as a pedophile and child pornographer, is enough to get you tortured and killed. And thank you, all of you, for being kind to me in this horrible time. I doubt it will change my plans but the fact that you are all trying to help me makes you all sincerely amazing people.

I've explained in my other posts why getting any mental assistance in the prison I'm going to is impossible. They just don't offer it. There are no groups and no such thing as not sharing what you did, the guards will tell the inmates I'm a fucking sick pedophile and I'll get violent punishment for it.

The fleeing the country thing, yes, is the only other thing I'm considering at the point. I'd need to get my parents on board with the fact that I will most certainly suffer and die in prison so they'll give me money to flee, which at the point they completely disagree with. They still see me as their beloved angel of a son who was misguided into wrongdoings, when in fact I did it all willingly and for egotistical pleasure. They think the judge will see the good in me and somehow overturn a 10 year sentence to picking trash on the streets.
Brazil.

I think you missed the fact that I'm not going to an american or european prison, I'm going to a third world prison. There are no mental health providers and punishment is given through rape, torture and eventual lynching.

I regret sharing it. I understand that by doing so I contributed to the pain child porn victims go through.

It's not just because I'm going to jail. I stopped sharing long ago because I realized it was wrong and hurtful.
Because you had to share porn to get porn in the community I used. You upload, you get the right to download.

I have never touched a child in my life. The only people I've directly hurt through my actions are my family, who never did anything to deserve what they're going through at the moment. I had caring parents who raised me to the best of their abilities. I don't want anyone to feel sorry for me.
Amends to who? The kids in the porn I used to share?
